admin.key_help: Paste the key from your Link Robins dashboard. Your forum's email then goes out through us over HTTPS, so a host that blocks SMTP ports stops mattering. Saving checks the key straight away.
admin.not_selected: Your key works, but this forum is not using Swoop to send. Choose Swoop under Email in the admin settings — until you do, mail goes out however it did before.
admin.balance_low: {count} left. Top up before you run out — when the balance is empty your forum falls back to its own mail settings.
admin.balance_unknown: Connect a key to see how many emails you have left.
admin.delivery_none: Nothing reported yet. Numbers appear once your forum has sent some mail.
admin.replies_help: Account emails normally come from an address nobody reads. Anyone who answers one of yours ends up here instead.
admin.test_sent: Sent to {email}. If it does not arrive within a minute or two, check spam before changing anything.
admin.test_help: Sends one real email to your own address, so you find out the whole path works before a new member does. It costs one email from your balance.
admin.service_url_help: Where the key is checked and messages are handed over. Leave this alone unless you have been given a different address; it should look like https://linkrobins.com, with no path after the host.
admin.connected: Connected. Your forum's email is going out through Swoop.
admin.not_connected: Not connected. This forum's email is still going out through whichever driver is selected under Admin → Email.
admin.scope_note: Swoop is a mail driver, so once it is selected under Admin → Email it carries everything this forum sends — confirmations, password resets, notifications and digests alike. Your forum writes the message; Swoop only delivers it.
